title: The Morning Row
description: A woman takes up sculling at dawn to reclaim her mornings and find clarity on the open water.
character_reference: an athletic woman with shoulder-length blonde hair tied in a messy ponytail, wearing a fitted grey athletic long-sleeve shirt

scenes.narration: Long before the alarm clocks buzzed across the valley, Clara pushed her sleek wooden shell away from the silent dock.
scenes.visual: wide shot of a single scull gliding onto a mirror-flat lake at twilight, mist rising from the water surface

scenes.narration: For years, her mornings belonged to everyone else's schedule. Now, the river offered a different kind of demand.
scenes.visual: close-up of hands gripping an oar handle tightly, droplets of water glistening in the dim morning light

scenes.narration: She locked her blades into the water and drove her legs backward, feeling the boat surge forward with clean power.
scenes.visual: side profile of a rower pulling hard on an oar, muscles engaged, water splashing in a crisp arc

scenes.narration: The rhythmic catch and release cleared the mental clutter that had built up through weeks of office politics.
scenes.visual: low angle shot looking up at a rower gliding past reeds along the misty shoreline, calm and focused

scenes.narration: Halfway across the lake, she stopped rowing entirely, letting the boat glide while she caught her breath in the stillness.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a woman resting her arms across her oars, looking out across the vast, calm water as the sun peaks

scenes.narration: Turning back toward the boathouse, her arms ached, but her mind felt lighter than the morning mist.
scenes.visual: pov shot from the bow looking toward a wooden dock as the boat smoothly approaches in the golden light

scenes.visual: warm cinematic portrait of a smiling woman standing by the lakeshore with her oar resting against her shoulder
